title: SCO-Hyper-Meta-Double-GroupNN: A Double-Group SU(2) Hyper-/Meta-Graph Neural Network for Cooperative Spin-Crossover Potential Energy Surfaces
title_zh: SCO-Hyper-Meta-Double-GroupNN：用于协作自旋交叉势能面的双群 SU(2) 超/元图神经网络
summary: 学习磁性材料的势能表面需要解决耦合的局部自旋流形和几何挫折。我们引入了 SCO-Hyper-Meta-Double-GroupNN，这是一种纯几何架构，将预训练的 O(3) 等变主干与 SU(2) 自旋哈密顿量和协作超/元图交互相结合。解析热旋量密度矩阵提供非多项式二体和三体结构不变量，而受抑三角形超边和多壳侧向门将几何表示耦合到局部自旋流形。变分一致的双中心零规范自由能函数耦合了多重占据和有符号自旋方向，在推理时无需自旋输入即可产生保守的自动梯度力。
abstract: arXiv:2611.34547v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Learning potential energy surfaces for magnetic materials requires resolving coupled local spin manifolds and geometric frustration. We introduce SCO-Hyper-Meta-Double-GroupNN, a geometry-only architecture combining a pretrained O(3)-equivariant backbone with SU(2) spinor Hamiltonians and cooperative hyper-/meta-graph interactions. Analytic thermal spinor density matrices provide non-polynomial two- and three-body structural invariants, while frustrated-triangle hyperedges and a multi-shell sideway gate couple geometric representations to local spin manifolds. A variationally consistent, doubly-centered zero-gauge free-energy functional couples multiplet occupations and signed spin orientations, yielding conservative autograd forces without spin inputs at inference. On a first-principles Co-Cr-Ni benchmark comprising 346 training and 59 held-out validation supercells across crystalline, amorphous, glassy, and liquid regimes, compact models with 56k-77k parameters outperform a 207k-parameter spin-conditioned magnetic MACE baseline. Energy MAE decreases by 37-44%, reaching 3.82 versus 6.83 meV/atom, and force MAE decreases by 10.8-14.2 meV/Angstrom, reaching 165.8-169.2 versus 180.0 meV/Angstrom. The models preserve Kramers degeneracy to within 6×10⁻¹⁵ eV, predict equilibrium local magnetic moments from geometry alone with an absolute-moment MAE of 0.181,μ_B, and support stable molecular dynamics up to 2,200 K. This framework integrates local spinor symmetry and cooperative magnetic interactions into geometry-only interatomic potentials.

title: Generalizable Equivariant Diffusion Models for Non-Abelian Lattice Gauge Theory: Analytical Foundations and Numerical Scaling Tests
title_zh: 用于非阿贝尔晶格规范场的可推广等变扩散模型：分析基础和数值标度测试
summary: 规范不变扩散模型可用于在非阿贝尔格点规范理论中生成场构型的系综。此前，我们通过将基于L-CNN的扩散模型与Metropolis调整的退火Langevin算法（MAALA）相结合，展示了对这些理论进行建模的可行性。在这里，我们重点关注其背后的分析框架。具体而言，我们给出了群流形上反时随机微分方程的严格推导，讨论了去噪损失函数的规范不变性，并提供了关于格体积和反耦合系数β的标度行为的广泛数值基准。还给出了任意大小的威尔逊环的完整解析表达式以及正向过程中的拓扑电荷敏感性。
abstract: arXiv:2611.03530v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Gauge-equivariant diffusion models can be used to generate ensembles of field configurations in non-abelian lattice gauge theories. Previously, we demonstrated the feasibility of modeling these theories by combining L-CNN-based diffusion models with the Metropolis-adjusted annealed Langevin algorithm (MAALA). Here we focus on the underlying analytical framework. In particular, we present a rigorous derivation of the reverse-time stochastic differential equation on the group manifold, discuss the gauge invariance of the denoising loss function, and provide extensive numerical benchmarks regarding the scaling behavior with respect to the lattice volume and the inverse coupling β. Full analytical expressions for arbitrarily sized Wilson loops and the topological charge susceptibility during the forward process are given as well.

title: Geometry Sets the Neutral MLIP-DFT Gap in Non-Covalent Binding, and Charged Systems Fail
title_zh: 几何结构在非共价结合中设置中性 MLIP-DFT 间隙，带电系统失败
summary: 人们普遍认为，在筛选分子相互作用时，预训练的通用机器学习原子间势（MLIP）将取代显式量子化学。对于非共价结合，我们发现这种期望对于中性化学成立，而对于带电化学则失败。我们使用 RAPIDS（快速原子探针-目标交互发现支架）（一种无需训练的推理时间支架）对来自 9 个保真臂的 18 个基准的 5,567 个探针-目标二聚体进行审核，无需针对特定任务进行微调。
abstract: arXiv:2611.33830v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Pretrained universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are widely expected to substitute for explicit quantum chemistry when screening molecular interactions. On non-covalent binding we find that this expectation holds for neutral chemistry and fails for charged chemistry. We audit the FAIRChem UMA OMol head, without task-specific fine-tuning, on 5,567 probe-target dimers from 18 benchmarks across nine fidelity arms, using RAPIDS (Rapid Atomistic Probe-target Interaction Discovery Scaffold), a training-free inference-time scaffold. First, on neutral chemistry RAPIDS reaches a mean absolute error (MAE) of 1.37 kcal/mol, matching or beating every explicit DFT single-point fidelity (1.42-1.50 kcal/mol), so the remaining MLIP-DFT gap is geometric rather than a learned-surface error. Second, charged systems form a qualitatively different regime: MAE jumps to 8.5-22.9 kcal/mol across three charged benchmarks; DFT single-point rescoring does not restore accuracy, geometry reoptimization restores it for ionic hydrogen bonds and ion-molecule dimers, and the failure persists across all three MLIP backbones. Third, the residual failures are structured: signed biases cluster by chemistry family, and whether a fidelity fails catastrophically transfers across families more reliably than error magnitude, enabling cost-aware fidelity selection. RAPIDS-Select, a closed-form rule on cheap precomputed features, uses about 37% less compute than a strong static DFT baseline at matched accuracy, and on a newly computed charged benchmark cuts the catastrophe rate from 68% to 5.7%. On WetSenseBench, a wet-lab-grounded host-guest selectivity benchmark from eight sensing studies, RAPIDS without DFT follow-up recovers 82.9% pair-level agreement on the seven studies above its ~1 kcal/mol precision floor.

title: ILMlip: fast and universal machine-learning interatomic potentials
title_zh: ILMlip：快速通用的机器学习原子间势
summary: 随着新模型的快速出现，大规模预训练的机器学习原子间势不断变得更加准确，而且成本也越来越高：截至 2026 年 11 月，Matbench Discovery 的当前领先者（F1 分数 0.935）拥有 9.9×10⁷ 参数，需要 3600 个 GPU 小时来训练。这里介绍的 ILMlip 势针对速度和零射击精度进行了优化。它们是等变的、保守的消息传递潜力，其中每个组件都按照吞吐量进行排列：每对原子的工作量很少，而每个原子所需的工作量则尽可能多。
abstract: arXiv:2611.33538v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large-scale pretrained machine-learned interatomic potentials keep growing more accurate as new models appear at a rapid pace, and more expensive: the current leader of Matbench Discovery as of November 2026 (F1 score 0.935) has 9.9×10⁷ parameters and took 3.6 thousand GPU-hours to train. The ILMlip potentials presented here are optimised for speed as well as zero-shot accuracy. They are equivariant, conservative message-passing potentials in which every component is arranged for throughput: little work per pair of atoms and as much as needed per atom. Through ASE on one GPU, they run molecular dynamics up to about 10³ times faster than state-of-the-art message-passing potentials such as MACE (medium) and up to five times faster than NEP89 and DPA-4.1C. At the same time, six sizes with 1.4×10⁵ to 2.8×10⁷ parameters, pretrained on materials, molecules and solid acids, reach F1 scores of 0.75 to 0.91 on Matbench Discovery, placing the largest within 0.03 of the current leader. They therefore suit high-throughput, large or long simulations, and, being transferable, they are strong starting points for fine-tuning. Fine-tuned to six materials, the model of size S comes close to the ab initio force errors of a fine-tuned MACE, so it reaches reference-level accuracy at about 50 ns per atom and step (Cu fcc). Their components can be adopted separately, as a starting point for architectures with even better ratios of speed to accuracy. The ILMlip implementation is available at https://github.com/jhaens/ilmlip

title: Machine-Learning Spin-Fermion Models for Strongly Disordered Magnets: Sb-Doped MnTe
title_zh: 适用于强无序磁体的机器学习自旋费米子模型：掺锑 MnTe
summary: 金属交变磁体在自旋电子学方面很有前景，但大多数交变磁体都是绝缘的。掺杂可以诱导金属丰度，但会引入化学和磁性无序，这很难根据第一原理进行建模。在这里，我们引入了一种机器学习方法，将第一原理计算重新规范化为无序自旋费米子模型。学习的模型准确地再现了第一原理的磁和电子特性，并能够预测大型无序超级电池中数百万个不等价的远程交换耦合。应用于 Sb 掺杂 MnTe 时，该方法表明交变磁性持续高达约 25% Sb，并揭示无序展宽是控制自旋选择性的新因素。
abstract: arXiv:2611.33544v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Metallic altermagnets are promising for spintronics, but most altermagnets are insulating. Doping can induce metallicity, but introduces chemical and magnetic disorder that is challenging to model from first principles. Here, we introduce a machine-learning approach that renormalizes first-principles calculations onto disordered spin-fermion models. The learned models accurately reproduce first-principles magnetic and electronic properties and enable predictions of millions of inequivalent long-range exchange couplings in large disordered supercells. Applied to Sb-doped MnTe, the approach shows that altermagnetism persists up to about 25% Sb, and reveals disorder broadening as a new factor controlling spin selectivity. More broadly, our work opens a route to combining renormalization with machine-learned Hamiltonians for strongly disordered materials.

title: Shower Shapes and Data-Driven Simulation Studies using a Highly Granular Crystal ECAL
title_zh: 使用高度精细的晶体ECAL进行淋浴形状和数据驱动模拟研究
summary: 使用标准簇射剖面模型测量了通过高粒度晶体电磁量热仪原型观测到的事件的电子簇射形状，数据取自欧洲核子研究组织（CERN）质子同步加速器T9束线上的2025年测试束。研究发现，淋浴峰值、纵向形状参数和横向方差可以用对数正态分布很好地近似。根据这些分布，测得的吸收体特性与现有文献一致。在所有参数之间观察到与能量相关的相关性，在簇峰和簇形状参数之间相关性最强。
abstract: arXiv:2611.33226v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron shower shapes were measured using standard shower profile models for events observed with a highly granular crystal electromagnetic calorimeter prototype, with data taken from a 2025 test beam at the CERN Proton Synchrotron T9 beamline. The shower maximum, longitudinal shape parameter, and lateral variance were found to be well approximated by log-normal distributions. From these distributions, properties of the absorber were measured to be in agreement with existing literature. Energy-dependent correlations were observed between all parameters and most strongly between the shower maximum and the shower shape parameter. The distributions of energy and event-by-event pairwise log ratios of energy fractions in individual active volumes of the calorimeter conditional on the shower shape were found to be consistent with shifted and scaled Gamma and Fisher's-z distributions, respectively. Generative methods were developed to simulate the logarithm of shower shape variables using Gaussian copulas. Copula sampling for shower shape parameters was found to produce superior modeling of heavy tails observed for the shower maximum and longitudinal shape parameter distributions when compared to direct sampling from a correlated multivariate normal distribution. A copula method was also devised to sample full shower events conditional on the shower shape parameters by exploiting the observation that the vector of energy fractions follows a logistic Log-Gamma distribution, the joint relation implied by the observed Fisher's-z form of the pairwise log-ratios. The generative model was evaluated using standard manifold and classifier metrics and was found to approach the data-versus-data ceiling. The fastest generation time was found to be around 30 μs per particle shower.

title: Chemia: An LLM-Powered Automated Machine Learning Framework for Chemistry and Materials Discovery
title_zh: Chemia：一个基于大语言模型的自动化机器学习框架，用于化学和材料发现
summary: 机器学习（ML）在化学和材料科学中的应用日益广泛，但其更广泛的应用受到编程工作量、模型和超参数选择难度以及可重复性有限的制约。我们推出了Chemia，这是一个开源的、由配置驱动的自动化机器学习框架，其中在一个YAML文件中声明了完整建模工作流程，包括数据加载、拆分和特征化，以及模型竞争、贝叶斯超参数优化和结果导出。Chemia 结合了物理化学描述符、拓扑指纹和预训练的化学基础模型嵌入；接受单分子、多组分反应和用户提供的预先计算的描述符；
abstract: Machine learning (ML) is increasingly used in chemistry and materials science, but wider adoption is limited by programming effort, model and hyperparameter selection difficulty, and limited reproducibility. We present Chemia, an open-source, configuration-driven automated ML framework in which a complete modeling workflow—from data loading, splitting and featurization to model competition, Bayesian hyperparameter optimization and result export—is declared in a single YAML file. Chemia combines physicochemical descriptors, topological fingerprints and pretrained chemical foundation model embeddings; accepts single molecules, multicomponent reactions and user-supplied precomputed descriptors; and compares gradient-boosted trees, kernel methods and neural networks under a common protocol. We evaluated Chemia on molecular property regression and classification, reaction yield and selectivity prediction under random and out-of-distribution splits, and electrochemical property prediction for metal–organic framework supercapacitors from externally computed descriptors. In most tasks Chemia reached test performance similar to original studies or benchmark literature without task-specific code, but was less accurate for volumetric capacitance and extrapolation to unseen ligands. We also describe Chemia-Agent, in which an LLM agent operates Chemia only by editing YAML configurations; in a recorded case study, the agent repaired configuration errors and aligned its evaluation protocol with the original study. Chemia is freely available under the MIT license at https://github.com/flyben97/Chemia. Scientific contribution Chemia brings single-molecule property prediction, multicomponent reaction modeling and precomputed-descriptor materials modeling into one declarative, schema-validated YAML workflow that combines descriptor, fingerprint and pretrained-embedding representations with automated model competition, whereas existing chemistry AutoML tools such as Uni-QSAR, QSARtuna, ChemTorch and ProQSAR each cover only part of this scope. Because every modeling decision is an explicit configuration field, Chemia workflows are reproducible and auditable, and the same YAML layer gives LLM agents a constrained action space in which they can configure, diagnose and repair modeling workflows without generating Python code.

title: Investigating the efficacy of vortex beam speckle patterns for the recognition of atmospheric turbulence and fractional topological charge with a deep learning model
title_zh: 利用深度学习模型研究涡旋光束斑点图案在大气湍流和分数拓扑荷识别方面的有效性
summary: 分数拓扑电荷（TC）扩大了轨道角动量（OAM）链路的可用模式集，但在大气湍流之后可靠地读取它仍然很困难。干涉法和衍射法需要未失真的光束和精心的对准，而大多数机器学习方法处理的是整数或间距较粗的拓扑荷，并且不考虑湍流。在这里，我们探讨的是否可以直接从单幅斑点图像中回归标量涡旋光束的电荷，以及在何种湍流强度下这种方法不再有效。
abstract: arXiv:2611.34573v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fractional topological charge (TC) enlarges the usable mode set of orbital angular momentum (OAM) links, but reading it reliably after atmospheric turbulence remains difficult. Interferometric and diffractive methods need an undistorted beam and a careful alignment, while most learned approaches treat integer or coarsely spaced charges and do not include turbulence. Here we ask whether the charge of a scalar vortex beam can be regressed directly from a single speckle image, and at which turbulence strength this stops working. We propagate vortex beams over 1500~m through 150 von Kármán phase screens, scatter them with a fixed random diffuser, and record 256×256, 16-bit speckle images for TC from 0 to 10 in steps of 0.01 and turbulence strengths D/r₀ from 0 to 50; the results reported here use a subset of 20,000 images, and a data set of 10⁶ images is in preparation. A convolutional neural network estimates the TC and, through an auxiliary head, the turbulence category. On charges withheld from training, the mean absolute error is 0.031 without turbulence (with a common intensity scale) and rises to 0.78 at D/r₀=10 and 1.85 at D/r₀=50, against 2.5 for a constant prediction, and the turbulence category is identified correctly in 78% of the images. The results show that, at the present training size, the charge is read accurately only without turbulence, and that the charge and the turbulence oth act on the speckle grain size, which may limit the readout. Experimental validation and the extension to vector vortex beams are left for future work.

title: Foundation interatomic potentials capture structural disorder in metallic glasses
title_zh: 基础原子间势捕获金属玻璃中的结构紊乱
summary: 基础机器学习原子间势能在化学和结构空间之间很好地传递，但其对于高度无序金属态的可靠性尚不明确。金属玻璃是一个要求很高的基准：传统上，它们是使用适合特定成分的嵌入式原子方法（EAM）势来建模的，而从头算分子动力学在所需的尺寸和时间尺度上仍然过于昂贵。使用原型 Cu-Zr-Al 玻璃，我们表明基础电势可以捕获结构无序，以接近第一原理的精度再现非晶态的结构、淬火动力学以及弹性、机械和热性能。
abstract: arXiv:2611.34156v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation machine-learning interatomic potentials transfer well across chemical and structural space, yet their reliability for highly disordered metallic states is less established. Metallic glasses are a demanding benchmark: they have traditionally been modeled with Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potentials fitted to specific compositions, while ab initio molecular dynamics remains too expensive at the required sizes and timescales. Using the prototypical Cu-Zr-Al glass, we show that foundation potentials capture structural disorder, reproducing the structure, quenching dynamics, and elastic, mechanical and thermal properties of the amorphous state at near first-principles accuracy. We benchmark MACE foundation models against a classical EAM potential along molecular dynamics quenches, validating against density functional theory and experiment, first at Cu46Zr46Al8 and then across the good glass-forming region of the ternary. We further test two specialization routes: fine-tuning on glass structures generated with Lennard-Jones surrogate models, and on automatically generated small periodic cells (ASSYST). Models pre-trained on databases that include non-equilibrium liquid and amorphous configurations, such as OMAT, are accurate and transferable across composition out of the box, clearly outperforming the composition-specific EAM potential. Fine-tuning on target glass structures brings only modest gains, while specialization on small crystalline cells degrades the description of disorder. The readiness of foundation potentials for disordered metals is therefore set mainly by the diversity of their pre-training data rather than by system-specific fine-tuning, shifting the modeling effort from bespoke dataset generation to pre-training coverage and careful validation of the resulting dynamics.

title: Data-enhanced self-learning projective quantum Monte Carlo with Rydberg-atom measurements
title_zh: 具有里德伯原子测量的数据增强自学习投影量子蒙特卡罗
summary: 我们引入了一种数据增强型自学习投影量子蒙特卡罗（PQMC）方法，该方法将可编程量子模拟器的投影测量合并到基态投影的引导波函数中。我们演示了使用受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）和循环神经网络（RNN）引导波函数的二维里德堡原子阵列的方法。实验性预训练减少了有限群体效应并加速了自学习收敛，从而可以通过更少的步行者和更少的自学习迭代来获得基态属性的无偏估计。 RBM 的改进尤其明显，而更准确的 RNN 引导波函数从预训练中获得的收益虽然较小，但仍然可观察到。
abstract: arXiv:2611.34636v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a data-enhanced self-learning projective quantum Monte Carlo (PQMC) method that incorporates projective measurements from programmable quantum simulators into the guiding wavefunction of a ground-state projection. We demonstrate the approach for a two-dimensional Rydberg-atom array using restricted Boltzmann machine (RBM) and recurrent neural network (RNN) guiding wavefunctions. Experimental pretraining reduces finite-population effects and accelerates self-learning convergence, allowing unbiased estimation of ground-state properties to be obtained with fewer walkers and fewer self-learning iterations. The improvement is particularly pronounced for the RBM, while the more accurate RNN guiding wavefunction exhibits a smaller, though still observable, benefit from pretraining. Simulations across different system sizes suggest that the relative advantage of experimental pretraining may increase with system size. Improvements are also observed for the checkerboard order parameter, despite deviations of the experimental measurements from the equilibrium numerical results. Finally, finite-size scaling with self-learning PQMC without experimental pretraining yields the critical point and critical exponents of the disordered-to-checkerboard transition in agreement with previous numerical studies. Our results show that limited and imperfect experimental measurements can provide an effective initialization for self-learning PQMC, while imaginary-time projection combined with subsequent unsupervised learning progressively refines the guiding wavefunction toward the ground state.

title: PineIR: 3D molecular structures from an infrared spectrum alone
title_zh: PineIR：仅来自红外光谱的 3D 分子结构
summary: 根据分子结构计算分子的红外 (IR) 光谱是常规做法。反问题则不然。在实践中，红外光谱用于识别分子中存在的官能团，而确定其完整结构则需要额外的测量。存在从红外光谱返回 3D 结构的机器学习模型，但所有这些模型都需要额外的输入，例如拉曼、紫外或核磁共振光谱、分子式或原子数。在这项工作中，我们提出了 PineIR，这是一种仅从红外光谱返回 3D 分子结构的生成模型。 PineIR 逐个原子地构建分子，每个原子都与其对红外光谱的贡献相关联。
abstract: arXiv:2611.34334v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Computing the infrared (IR) spectrum of a molecule from its structure is routine. The inverse problem is not. In practice, IR spectra are used to identify the functional groups present in a molecule, while the determination of its complete structure requires additional measurements. Machine-learning models that return 3D structures from IR spectra exist, but all of them need extra input, such as Raman, ultraviolet or nuclear magnetic resonance spectra, the molecular formula, or the number of atoms. In this work we present PineIR, a generative model that returns 3D molecular structures from the IR spectrum alone. PineIR builds the molecule atom by atom, and each atom is associated with its contribution to the IR spectrum. This contribution is subtracted from the input spectrum before the next atom is generated. To train it, we computed with a machine-learned interatomic potential the IR spectra of 4.6 million structures of 3.1 million molecules, including conformer ensembles. On computed spectra of held-out molecules, the best-ranked of fifty candidates has the correct connectivity in 43% of the cases, and the generated geometries reproduce the conformer and the diastereomer that produced the input spectrum. After fine-tuning on 161k spectra calculated with the hybrid functional B3LYP, the model can also be applied to spectra at this level of theory.

title: Phono3GPU: GPU-Accelerated Linear Tetrahedron Integration for Phonon Thermal Transport
title_zh: Phono3GPU：用于声子热传输的 GPU 加速线性四面体集成
summary: 高导热率或低导热率的材料对于热管理和能源技术越来越重要。机器学习的原子间势加速了非谐力常数计算，将瓶颈转向大型材料数据集的声子输运计算。现有的 GPU 求解器通常依赖于涂抹，其宽度可能需要根据材料进行选择，而 phono3py 中使用的线性四面体方法避免了此参数，但对于复杂结构而言成本高昂。在这里，我们介绍 Phono3GPU，它重新表述了三声子散射和线性四面体积分，以实现大规模并行 GPU 执行。
abstract: arXiv:2611.33912v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Materials with high or low thermal conductivity are increasingly important for thermal management and energy technologies. Machine-learned interatomic potentials have accelerated anharmonic force-constant calculations, shifting the bottleneck toward phonon transport calculations for large materials datasets. Existing GPU solvers often rely on smearing, whose width can require material-dependent choices, while the linear tetrahedron method used in phono3py avoids this parameter but becomes costly for complex structures. Here we introduce Phono3GPU, which reformulates three-phonon scattering and linear tetrahedron integration for massively parallel GPU execution. Across benchmark crystals, Phono3GPU accelerates total calculations by up to 41 times relative to a CPU implementation, with larger gains for complex unit cells, and by 2 to 6 times relative to a recent GPU plug-in for phono3py. We further demonstrate atom-resolved scattering analysis in defective silicon supercells as an application enabled by the reduced computational cost. Phono3GPU thus lowers the cost of tetrahedron-based thermal-conductivity calculations and of detailed investigations of structure-dependent phonon transport.

title: A general-purpose electron density model for molecular chemistry
title_zh: 分子化学的通用电子密度模型
summary: 通用机器学习潜力可以以量子力学的精度预测分子结构和稳定性，而成本却很低。来自电子结构知识的属性可以对化学反应性提供深刻的见解，但无法以同样的容易性或可转移性获得。我们在 400 万个处于多种电荷和自旋状态的 OMol25 结构上训练 PET-rho-OMol25，这是分子系统的基态电子密度和自旋极化模型。
abstract: arXiv:2611.34732v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Universal machine-learning potentials predict molecular structure and stability at the accuracy of quantum mechanics, for a fraction of the cost. Properties derived instead from knowledge of the electronic structure give profound insights into chemical reactivity, but are not accessible with the same ease or transferability. We train PET-rho-OMol25, a model of the ground-state electron density and spin polarization of molecular systems on four million OMol25 structures in multiple charge and spin states. The model makes predictions for entire proteins in a few seconds on a single GPU, and enables estimation of important diagnostics of molecular structure and reactivity, such as vibrational Stark measurements, halogen σ-holes, hydrogen-bond basicities and core-level shifts, as well as spin density for redox chemistry and magnetism. PET-rho-OMol25 has an accuracy close to density-functional theory, with its least reliable predictions flagged by its built-in uncertainty estimator, for most properties and classes of compounds. It can be used as a drop-in replacement for electronic-structure calculations of the density, making insightful analyses available for larger and more complex structures.

title: PerovAgent: Autonomous Ligand Design for Halide Perovskite Nanocrystals
title_zh: PerovAgent：卤化物钙钛矿纳米晶体的自主配体设计
summary: 为高性能卤化物钙钛矿纳米晶体设计表面覆盖配体需要探索广阔的分子空间，同时发现控制配体-表面相互作用的设计规则。在这里，我们介绍 PerovAgent，一个自主多智能体框架，它将大语言模型 (LLM) 驱动的科学推理与用于原子模型构建、机器学习原子间势评估和统计验证的计算工具相结合。在 CsPbBr3 表面的十次独立活动中，PerovAgent 适应性地探索和完善了不同的配体化学，同时逐步提高了结合能目标。
abstract: arXiv:2611.33913v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Designing surface-capping ligands for high-performance halide perovskite nanocrystals requires navigating a vast molecular space while discovering design rules that govern ligand-surface interactions. Here, we introduce PerovAgent, an autonomous multi-agent framework that combines large language model (LLM)-driven scientific reasoning with computational tools for atomistic model construction, machine-learned interatomic potential evaluation, and statistical validation. Across ten independent campaigns on CsPbBr3 surfaces, PerovAgent adaptively explored and refined diverse ligand chemistries while progressively improving the binding-energy objective. Beyond optimization, the framework converts recurring chemical observations into explicit design principles that can be statistically evaluated. Of 35 formulated principles, 19 were prospectively supported, of which seven also passed the confound audit, highlighting the need to systematically validate plausible LLM-generated hypotheses during autonomous discovery. A recurrent alkynyl-phosphonate principle was further examined using density functional theory, which reproduced the predicted energetic preference. These results demonstrate an autonomous discovery framework that not only searches molecular space and optimizes the scalar objective but also transforms its search trajectory into systematically testable design principles. The framework can also be extended to more complex ligands, including zwitterionic, multidentate, and polymerizable ligands, to explore a wider range of ligand-surface interactions and uncover new design principles for halide perovskite nanocrystals.

title: Anisotropic Crystallization Kinetics and Interfacial Dynamics of Phase-Change Material Sb₂S₃
title_zh: 相变材料Sb2S₃的各向异性结晶动力学和界面动力学
summary: 硫化锑 (Sb2S₃) 是一种地球上储量丰富且可持续的硫族化物，由于其超低光学损耗、宽带透明度和可逆相变能力，已成为一种有前途的相变材料 (PCM)。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种基于矩张量势方法的机器学习力场，通过大规模分子动力学模拟（40 ns 最多 7680 个原子），使我们首次了解 Sb2S₃ 结构演化和结晶动力学的原子起源。
abstract: arXiv:2605.20785v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Antimony sulfide (Sb₂S₃), an Earth-abundant and sustainable chalcogenide, has emerged as a promising phase change material (PCM) due to its ultra-low optical losses, broadband transparency, and reversible phase-change capacity. In this work, we developed a machine learning force field based on the moment tensor potential approach, allowing us to understand the atomistic origin of the structural evolution and crystallization kinetics in Sb₂S₃ for the first time, by enabling large-scale molecular dynamics simulations (up to 7680 atoms for 40 ns). Sb₂S₃ has anisotropic growth rates with the (100) facet (Pnma space group) exhibiting the fastest growth due to the strong Sb-S covalent bonding along its quasi-1D ribbon-like structure of its crystalline phase. The maximum growth rate was observed at 875 K, with an optimal undercooling degree of ~100 K, significantly lower than other PCMs like Ge₂Sb₂Te₅ (GST) and GeTe. The activation energy for crystal growth was calculated be around 0.56 eV. Interfacial atomic dynamics revealed an Arrhenius-to-non-Arrhenius transition at ~800 K, with the (100) facet showing the highest diffusion activation energy of 1.56 eV. Unlike the GST and GeTe, the lower activation energy for crystal growth in Sb₂S₃ indicates that its heterogeneous crystallization is interface-controlled rather than diffusion-limited, with atomic attachment at the solid-liquid interface being energetically favoured over long-range atomic transport. Bonding and ring statistics analyses confirmed that directional covalent bonding plays a fundamental role in guiding structural ordering during crystal growth. These findings provide key insights into the structural, thermodynamic, and kinetic properties of Sb₂S₃, paving the way for optimizing its functionality including switching speed, reliability, and energy efficiency.

title: Discovering Explicit Magnetic Core-Loss Equations via Symbolic Sparse Identification
title_zh: 通过符号稀疏识别发现显式磁芯损耗方程
summary: 紧凑型铁芯损耗方程是磁性元件设计中必不可少的工具，但现有方法在准确性与可解释性之间存在权衡。Steinmetz方程 (SE) 等经验模型可得出精度有限的简洁表达式，而机器学习方法作为黑箱预测器可实现高精度。本文通过符号稀疏识别 (SSI) 框架弥补了这一缺憾，该框架将铁芯损耗建模视为一个数据驱动的符号回归问题，并直接从测量数据中恢复未知方程，而无需预先假设函数形式。首先，构建了一个比 SE 丰富得多的符号候选项的全面扩展库。其次，通过稀疏回归将主导项从该库中分离出来。
abstract: arXiv:2611.33364v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Compact core loss equations are essential tools in magnetic component design, but existing approaches trade accuracy against interpretability. Empirical models such as the Steinmetz Equation (SE) yield compact expressions of limited accuracy, while machine learning methods achieve high accuracy as black-box predictors. This paper bridges the gap with a Symbolic Sparse Identification (SSI) framework, which casts core loss modeling as a data-driven symbolic regression problem and recovers unknown equations directly from measured data, without presuming a functional form. First, a comprehensively expanded library of symbolic candidate terms far richer than the SE is constructed. Second, the governing terms are isolated from this library by sparse regression. Third, the coefficients of the retained terms are refined with an AdamW optimizer to maximize accuracy and form an analytical equation. Experiments on Fair-Rite 78, 79, and 95 yield test mean absolute percentage errors of 1.89%, 1.01%, and 1.56%, respectively, with only 10, 10, and 7 active terms. Comparisons with empirical, numerical, and symbolic models quantify the resulting balance of accuracy and compactness. SSI thus provides an explicit and physically guided approach for high-frequency magnetic characterization and design.

title: Magnetic Contributions to Phase Stability in the Co-Ni Binary: A First-Principles CALPHAD Study
title_zh: 磁性对 Co-Ni 二元相稳定性的贡献：第一性原理 CALPHAD 研究
summary: 我们提出了一种简单的方法，采用从头计算来确定磁性对合金自由能的贡献。对 Co-Ni 二元的验证表明，这种从头开始的方法重现了实验性 FCC-HCP 相平衡，同时提供了适合多组分外推的物理透明、结构相关的磁参数。我们的结果表明，直接从电子结构计算得出的物理接地磁参数化可以实现磁性合金系统的预测相图建模。
abstract: arXiv:2607.12388v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose a simple method to employ ab-initio calculations to determine magnetic contributions to free energy of alloys. Validation on the Co-Ni binary demonstrates that this ab initio approach reproduces experimental FCC-HCP phase equilibria while providing physically transparent, structure-dependent magnetic parameters suitable for multicomponent extrapolation. Our results demonstrate that physically grounded magnetic parametrization, derived directly from electronic structure calculations, enables predictive phase diagram modeling for magnetic alloy systems.

title: Chiral Domain-Wall Modes in Topological Adaptive Quantum Dynamics
title_zh: 文献研究：Chiral Domain-Wall Modes in Topological Adaptive Quantum Dynamics
summary: Quantum dynamical systems driven by both unitary evolution and measurements open a new landscape of nonequilibrium phases of matter. The role of topology in enriching this landscape remains less under…
abstract: arXiv:2611.33328v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum dynamical systems driven by both unitary evolution and measurements open a new landscape of nonequilibrium phases of matter. The role of topology in enriching this landscape remains less understood than that of entanglement and symmetry. A particularly interesting question concerns protected dynamical modes localized on spacetime domain walls between topologically distinct dynamical phases. These dynamical topological domain-wall modes (DTDMs) are well understood only for 0+1D walls in 1+1D fermionic dynamics. In this work, we study 1+1D topological domain walls in 2+1D charge-conserving free-fermion dynamics, modeled by topological adaptive circuits that steer the two sides of each wall toward a Chern insulator and a trivial insulator through measurements and feedforward corrections. Although the circuits target no particular wall state, each wall hosts 1+1D chiral DTDMs. At long times in each quantum trajectory, they exhibit logarithmic scaling of entanglement and charge variance and algebraically decaying density correlations, surprisingly consistent with the ground state of a 1+1D chiral free-fermion conformal field theory. This contrasts with purely 1+1D charge-conserving free-fermion dynamics, which exhibits only area-law entanglement at finite measurement rates. We also show that the chiral DTDMs exhibit slow purification dynamics. When the system starts from a maximally mixed state, the DTDMs' entropy decays algebraically, accompanied by a vanishing Lyapunov gap, whereas each domain purifies on an O(1) timescale. Finally, we propose a physical picture for the long-time behavior of the DTDMs by treating the adaptive circuit model as a quantum cooling algorithm. Our results show that topological phases of adaptive dynamics can protect chiral modes on spacetime domain walls against repeated wavefunction collapse and Born-rule randomness.

title: Emergent Chern metal in strongly correlated moiré bilayers
title_zh: 强相关莫尔双层中出现的陈金属
summary: 我们研究了强相关的莫尔过渡金属二硫化物 (TMD) 双层（例如扭曲的 MoTe2 或 WSe2）的拓扑特性，该双层具有与层偏振螺旋自旋纹理耦合的自旋电荷分离态。通过分析移动无自旋完整子穿过非共面自旋背景的有效低能哈密顿量，我们揭示了明显的不对称能带扭曲。这种扭曲关闭了大部分参数空间的全局间接带隙，将真正的拓扑绝缘体限制在微调的临界轨迹上。然而，有限的局部直接间隙仍然存在，稳定了拓扑陈金属的大范围区域 (C = ± 1)。
abstract: arXiv:2611.34780v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the topological properties of a strongly correlated moiré transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) bilayer (such as twisted MoTe₂ or WSe₂) hosting a spin-charge separated state coupled to a layer-polarized helical spin texture. Analyzing an effective low-energy Hamiltonian for mobile spinless holons moving through this non-coplanar spinon background, we reveal pronounced asymmetric band warping. This warping closes the global indirect band gap across most of the parameter space, restricting true topological insulators to fine-tuned critical trajectories. However, a finite local direct gap persists, stabilizing broad regions of a topological Chern metal (C = ± 1). Computing the Chern number and density of states, we demonstrate that this phase naturally yields a sizable, non-quantized anomalous Hall response accompanied by finite longitudinal conduction, providing a purely electronic strong-coupling mechanism for dissipative anomalous Hall states in moiré systems.

title: Reflected entropy and Markov gap in Lifshitz theories
title_zh: 文献研究：Reflected entropy and Markov gap in Lifshitz theories
summary: We study the reflected entropy in (1+1)--dimensional Lifshitz field theory whose groundstate is described by a quantum mechanical model. Starting from tripartite Lifshitz groundstates, both critical a…
abstract: arXiv:2307.12247v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study the reflected entropy in (1+1)--dimensional Lifshitz field theory whose groundstate is described by a quantum mechanical model. Starting from tripartite Lifshitz groundstates, both critical and gapped, we derive explicit formulas for the Rényi reflected entropies reduced to two adjacent or disjoint intervals, directly in the continuum. We show that the reflected entropy in Lifshitz theory does not satisfy monotonicity, in contrast to what is observed for free relativistic fields. We analytically compute the full reflected entanglement spectrum for two disjoint intervals, finding a discrete set of eigenvalues which is that of a thermal density matrix. Furthermore, we investigate the Markov gap, defined as the difference between reflected entropy and mutual information, and find it to be universal and nonvanishing, signaling irreducible tripartite entanglement in Lifshitz groundstates. We also obtain analytical results for the reflected entropies and the Markov gap in 2 + 1 dimensions. Finally, as a byproduct of our results on reflected entropy, we provide exact formulas for two other entanglement-related quantities, namely the computable cross-norm negativity and the operator entanglement entropy.
